capabilities: Extract text from images via OCR
Run OCR on the last image in the active note, a path, or a right-clicked file
Copy OCR results to the clipboard
Display OCR results in the sidebar for highlighting and copying
Select the OCR language, with RTL support for Arabic
extras: Supports only png, jpg and jpeg files; the README notes accuracy limits of Tesseract.js and that more file extensions may be added in the future.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull text out of images, so text embedded in screenshots or photos has to be retyped manually.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses Tesseract.js, which is not perfect and hence may result in unexpected outputs for some images.

summary: OCR plugin that extracts text from images in over 100 languages using Tesseract.js and shows the result in the sidebar or clipboard.
